records.title: Closed form first, then bound by proving the tail is positive
records.strategy: Use induction to derive an exact formula, normalize with `ring_nf`, and finish by proving the subtracted tail is positive.

records.title: Do not call `linarith` before the recurrence is unfolded
records.attempted_step: Ask `linarith` to solve the successor case directly from the induction hypothesis.
records.failure_signal: The nonlinear tail term remains opaque and the tactic makes no progress.
records.better_direction: Rewrite the recurrence, substitute the induction hypothesis, and normalize before using linear arithmetic.

records.title: Evidence citations need relative paths and local line hints
records.rule: Every handoff memory must cite a repository-relative path plus a local line hint or theorem name.
records.reason: Reviewers need enough context to verify a record without reopening the whole session.

records.title: `pow_pos` is the stable bridge for positive-tail bounds
records.why_it_matters: It gives an explicit proof that denominator powers stay positive before finishing the inequality.
